inputs.caption:
### Global Metadata
Genre and subgenres: melancholic Japanese indie-pop ballad in the style of Yorushika; wistful, literary, with the feel of an anime ending song. Tempo: relaxed mid-tempo around 78 BPM, in F# minor. Emotional progression: opens in a soft, nostalgic reverie of a late-summer evening; the verses drift through memory in quiet introspection; the chorus gently swells into a warm, bittersweet release — sad but never anguished, tender but never loud — then falls back through a hushed bridge into a lingering, almost resigned conclusion. Application imagery: a girl walking home alone at night through the last light of summer, the tap of her shoes on the asphalt like tiny fireworks, a fireworks-lit sky far away, an empty street, a fading memory of someone she used to know. Sonics & production: warm, intimate, slightly lo-fi-tinted acoustic sound; crisp fingerpicked acoustic guitar and soft piano at the core; airy, spacious mix with a gentle tape-warmth; restrained dynamics — verses nearly whisper-quiet, choruses bloom only slightly fuller; no wall-of-sound, no harsh top-end, everything sounds like a memory being retold.

Melodic design (top priority): the melody must be instantly memorable and quietly hook-driven, in a minor key. Compose a short signature motif of 4–6 notes with a gentle, nostalgic contour — a small leap that lands on an unresolved, aching note — and state it alone on fingerpicked acoustic guitar in the intro as the song's emotional anchor. Recur this motif — literal or transposed — at the opening of every section and as a wordless hum in the outro, so the ear locks on by the first chorus. The chorus melody should open a step higher than the verse and resolve the motif on the title phrase 靴の花火 for a wistful singalong pull.

### Vocal Details
Lead: a single female vocalist in the style of Yorushika's vocalist — a clear, gentle, slightly husky and breathy voice with an intimate, literary, storytelling delivery of Japanese lyrics; phrasing is unhurried and slightly detached, like remembering. Vocal style: verses are near-spoken, soft and close to the mic; the chorus lifts into a warm, full but never belted melody — the signature motif set to the title phrase 靴の花火 with its aching leap, crisp diction on the hook notes, a small falling ornament just before the resolve to give it a melancholy earworm quality. Harmony/backing: occasional light double-tracked self-harmonies, airy and distant, appearing only in the chorus, never dominant. Vocal FX: a touch of tape-saturation warmth, gentle plate reverb, subtle delay on phrase endings; no distortion and no shouting at any point.

### Arrangement
Intro: a solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar states the signature motif alone, warm and intimate, like the first breath of a memory; a soft piano answers faintly on the second repeat. Verse: fingerpicked guitar and a warm upright piano frame the near-spoken vocal; the motif returns quietly under the last line of each verse as a gentle recall. Pre-chorus: soft strings and a low sustained pad swell underneath as the motif rises a step, building quiet tension. Chorus: the band enters gently — soft brushed drums and a warm round bass — as the vocal delivers the hook, the leap landing squarely on 靴の花火; airy backing harmonies bloom around the motif, then the arrangement recedes rather than pushing. Second verse: even quieter, just guitar and voice for the first lines before the pad returns. Bridge: the texture thins to piano and a distant electric guitar echoing the motif, inverted and slowed, a moment of pure reflection; a soft cymbal swell leads back. Final chorus: the warmest and fullest, yet still restrained — a touch more light in the strings and harmony voices, then an impact-free, almost weightless lift into the outro. Outro: everything falls away, the fingerpicked guitar returns to the motif one last time and the vocal hums it wordlessly, letting the melody fade like a summer that has ended.
inputs.lyrics:
[intro]
（指弾きギターだけのイントロ）

[verse]
街灯がひとつずつ 橙に変わって
夏の終わりが 靴音に混ざる
言わなかった言葉が 歩くたびに
小さな花火になって 弾けてく

[pre-chorus]
夕暮れの空に ひとつだけ
君の影を 探してしまう

[chorus]
靴の花火 鳴らして歩こう
誰もいない夜道を
大きな火の花が 咲いたなら
あの夏が 少しだけ 戻る気がした
忘れないで なんて言わないから
今日の空だけ 覚えていて

[verse]
枯れそうな蝉の声 遠くで鳴いて
指で数えた 交差点の数
置いてきたものばかり 数えてるのに
明日は もうすぐ やって来る

[pre-chorus]
朝焼けの空に 手を伸ばせば
君の名前が 落ちていく

[chorus]
靴の花火 鳴らして歩こう
誰もいない夜道を
大きな火の花が 咲いたなら
あの夏が 少しだけ 戻る気がした
忘れないで なんて言わないから
今日の空だけ 覚えていて

[bridge]
（ギターとピアノだけ、静かな余白）
立ち止まって 空を仰いだ
花火はもう 消えてしまったけど

[final chorus]
靴の花火 鳴らして歩こう
誰もいない夜道を
大きな火の花が 咲いたなら
あの夏が 少しだけ 戻る気がした
忘れないで なんて言わないから
今日の空だけ 覚えていて
きっと 明日も 晴れるから

[outro]
（指弾きギターが薄れて、声も消える）
また いつか——
ねぇ
